messages:
elaine: Quick ask — we need a compact battlecard refresh for next week's launch: 1) one-sentence competitor frame vs cloud AI platforms, LLM APIs, infra vendors 2) top 3 proof points + simple benchmark numbers 3) a single webinar hook. Can we draft today? :timer_clock:
marco: +1. I can sketch the competitor frames. Thinking: Cloud AI = 'managed but opaque economics', LLM API = 'easy to call, poor production guarantees', Infra vendors = 'flexible but ops-heavy'. Keep it punchy.
rev: @marco can you add quick proof points per frame? e.g., p95 latency, cost/tk, deploy time. Need sources.
elsie: Question — do we have a canonical hosted vs dedicated vs private stat set? Sanjay maybe?
sanjay: I can run a 2-model microbench: 8k seq, batch sizes 1/8, evaluate p50/p95, tokens/sec. ETA EOD. I'll include quantized variant.
marco: Draft of frames:

```
Cloud AI platforms — easy endpoint access, brittle unit economics at scale; we show 2–5x cost reduction with batching/caching.
LLM APIs — fastest dev loop, limited SLAs and routing; proof: automated fallback + dedicated pools reduces OOS by 3x.
Infra vendors — raw speed/choice but high ops; proof: unified runtime reduces rollouts from weeks to days.
```

elaine: Nice. Can someone convert those into 2-line soundbites and a one-slide benchmark visual? Tara for design?
tara: I can make a 1-up slide. Need exact numbers from Sanjay + a simple chart type preference (bar for cost, line for latency). Recommend stacked bars.
rev: Webinar hook idea: 'Serving First: How to make LLMs predictable, fast, and cheap' — 30m, demo of rollback and routing. Panel: eng + product + customer.
elaine: Love it. Marketing sync at 4p to finalize copy. @sanjay please drop raw csv into #marketing-assets with a short note.
sanjay: Will do. CSV and run command in logs:

```
./bench/run.sh --model=gpt-open-8k --seq=8192 --batch=8 --out=marketing_bench.csv
```

marco: Small ask: avoid using 'better than X' claims without numbers. Legal flagged 'better than' earlier. Use comparative proof points.
elsie: Noted. Also propose 3 TL;DR bullets for SDRs: 1) predictable unit economics, 2) consistent latency SLAs, 3) same toolchain for hosted/dedicated/private.
elaine: Perfect. I'll draft battlecard with those bullets + two rebuttal lines for common objections. Posting draft after 3p.
ops-bot: Reminder — quarterly webinar slot calendar updated: 2025-06-12 10:00 UTC reserved.
elaine: Great — confirm webinar date with events. Thanks team! :sparkles:
